title: Two strong shrill whistles answered through the calm.
html_source:
A shrill noise would be piercing and high pitched; the whistles would break through “the calm” atmosphere and disrupt it.

From the top of the tower, Buck can see across the port. He sees the steam come from the ship’s whistle and he whistles first, then they hear the ship’s reply–another indication of how clever and self-aware Buck is.

No one knows the exact source of these whistles, but one possibility is the mailboat (whose whistle was deep not shrill).

The three whistles, Buck’s and two replies, is a mockery of the sacring bell. The sacring bell, also known as the sanctus bell, is the bell which rings when the Host is elevated at the celebration of High Mass.
